notes: Uint8Array gives one byte per flag in a single contiguous buffer; fill(1) then fill(0, 0, 2).
Indices stay below 2^31, so V8 keeps them as small integers in the hot loops.
The sum stays below 2^53 for N ≤ 200000000, so a plain Number is exact (no BigInt needed).
One process.stdout.write for the three lines; the process exits naturally so the write is flushed.
